# Git Edge Cases — verify git behavior under unusual conditions

# === INIT ===
exec akb init git-kb
cd git-kb

# === VERIFY GIT REPO EXISTS ===
exists .git
exec git log --oneline
stdout 'akb: init git-kb'

# === NO GIT USER CONFIGURED — WRITE STILL WORKS ===

# The environment supplies an empty user.name, so the merged git config has no
# usable identity even when the machine sets one in its system or global
# config.
env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=user.name
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write no-user-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/no-user-note.md'

# Verify write created a commit
exec git log --oneline -1
stdout 'akb: write kb/notes/no-user-note.md'

# Verify the commit used the akb identity

exec git log -1 --format='%an <%ae>'
stdout 'akb <akb@local>'

# and that the repository identity was left untouched
! exec git config --local user.name

! exec git config --local user.email

# === DELETE ALSO WORKS WITHOUT USER CONFIG ===
exec akb delete notes/no-user-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/no-user-note.md'

# === GIT STATUS CLEAN AFTER OPERATIONS ===
stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write clean-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/clean-note.md'

exec git status --short
! stdout .

# === --no-commit DOES NOT CREATE COMMIT ===
stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb --no-commit write nocommit-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/nocommit-note.md'

exec git status --short
stdout 'nocommit-note.md'

# Clean up for subsequent tests
exec akb delete notes/nocommit-note.md
exec akb delete notes/clean-note.md

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Git Edge Case Note
summary: Note for git edge case testing
tags: gittest
---
Git edge case content.
